bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 纪录高点下方整理

read.en: NVIDIA set a record $243.37 on Oct 6 and has eased 6% since. The trend structure is still bullish: the 30-day ($225) and 100-day ($214) averages are rising and price is above both, and Parabolic SAR has been below price since Sep 28. Short-term momentum is fading. Price is under the 5 and 10-day averages, RSI cooled from 67 to 53, and the MACD histogram is almost back to zero, so a bearish cross is close.
read.zh: 英伟达于 10月6日创下 $243.37 纪录，此后回落 6%。趋势结构仍偏多：30 日（$225）与 100 日（$214）均线上行，股价位于两者之上，抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起位于股价下方。短线动能减弱：股价低于 5 日和 10 日均线，RSI 由 67 回落至 53，MACD 柱体几乎回到零轴，接近死叉。

read.en: The $220–225 zone (30-day average and the SAR level) is the first real support; below it, $215 (tested five times since April) and $208, the 20-day low. On the way up, $233–235 (short averages and September highs) is the first hurdle, then the $243 record.
read.zh: $220–225 区域（30 日均线与 SAR 位置）为首个有效支撑；其下为 $215（4月以来五次测试）及 20 日低点 $208。向上首先面对 $233–235（短期均线与9月高点），然后是 $243 纪录高点。
